title: When listening changes the outcome
summary: Building trust and shared value with communities in Argentina.
body_markdown:
“After more than 25 years of working in this space, I have learned the importance of close engagement and adaptability. Community engagement doesn’t follow office hours, and many of the conversations that matter most take place on the ground, when you’re present and willing to listen.


Understanding a community requires curiosity and the humility to recognise that the same situation may be interpreted very differently by the people who live in the area. While Salta, Jujuy and Catamarca provinces share the Puna landscape, each has its own cultural identity, history and social dynamics.


It’s also important to listen to different voices, not only the most visible ones or those who hold formal roles. Women, young people, older adults, rural smallholders and local families may have different perspectives and concerns.


I work to ensure that the business sees not only a request or a risk, but also the people behind it and the consequences that each decision may have locally.”
